description: 5 MCQ diagnostic questions — one per AI skill pillar. Used in onboarding Screen 3.

questions.text: You ask an AI tool to summarise a 10-page report and it confidently includes a statistic that isn't in the document. What is the most likely cause?

options.text: The AI searched the internet for additional data
The AI generated plausible-sounding text based on patterns, not facts
The report was too long and the AI skipped sections
The AI misread a number in the document

questions.explanation: AI language models generate statistically likely text — they don't verify facts. This is called hallucination and is a fundamental property of current LLMs.

questions.text: You need an AI to write a project status email. Which prompt is most likely to produce a useful first draft?

options.text: Write a project status email

Write a 150-word project status email for a stakeholder who doesn't know the technical details. The project is on track, key win this week was completing the API integration, one risk is the vendor deadline next Friday.
I need an email. Make it professional and clear.
Here is my draft, please improve it: [no draft provided]

questions.explanation: Effective prompts specify the role, format, length, audience, and key content. Vague prompts produce generic output; specific prompts produce useful drafts.

questions.text: You need to analyse 50 research papers and identify common themes. Which type of AI tool is best suited for this?

options.text: An image generation tool like Midjourney
A conversational chat tool like ChatGPT with a single paste
A deep research tool like Perplexity or NotebookLM that handles long documents
A workflow automation tool like Zapier

questions.explanation: Matching capability to task is key. Deep research / document analysis tools are designed for long-context synthesis across many sources — chat tools have context limits and no document management.

questions.text: You want an AI assistant to always respond in bullet points and never exceed 100 words. Where is the best place to set this instruction?

options.text: Repeat it at the start of every message
In the system prompt, so it applies to every response automatically
At the end of each message as a reminder
You cannot control response format — the AI decides

questions.explanation: System prompts are persistent instructions that shape all responses in a session or deployment. They're the primary tool for configuring consistent AI behaviour without repeating yourself.

questions.text: You regularly need to: research a topic → draft a report → translate to Chinese. You do each step manually with separate AI tools. What would make this workflow most efficient?

options.text: Use a single AI tool for all three steps
Design a chained prompt sequence where each output feeds the next step automatically
Hire someone to do the translation step
Do the research manually and only use AI for translation

questions.explanation: Prompt chaining — where the output of one AI step becomes the structured input of the next — is the foundation of multi-AI workflow design. It turns a manual 3-step process into a repeatable pipeline.
